title: Sovereign Election of God
definition: The sovereign election of God is His gracious choosing according to His purpose and mercy, never based on human merit.
summary: God's saving choice is rooted in grace, mercy, and His eternal purpose.
christFocus: Christ is the chosen and beloved Son in whom believers receive every saving blessing.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Election is a biblical doctrine that highlights God's grace in salvation. Scripture teaches that believers are chosen in Christ according to God's purpose and mercy, not because of foreseen worthiness.

This doctrine should not lead to pride, speculation, or coldness. It should produce humility, worship, assurance, evangelism, and gratitude.

Election is centered in Christ. God's saving purpose is not abstract; it is fulfilled in the beloved Son who redeems His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people think salvation ultimately rests on human wisdom, effort, or worthiness. Sovereign election matters because it shows that salvation is mercy from beginning to end.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Respond with humility and worship. Do not use this doctrine for argument or apathy. Let God's grace fuel assurance, holiness, and Gospel witness.
